title: Fail-loud font guard is dead code — silent raylib-default fallback still possible
detail: A missing/corrupt TTF yields nil glyphs; the loaders substitute GetFontDefault(), which IsFontValid accepts (baseSize>0, glyphs non-null) — the os.exit(2) checks can never fire, so the "silent-fallback lie" the comments claim is impossible remains fully possible.
recommended_fix: Delete the GetFontDefault fallbacks: return a zero/invalid Font on failure so the existing IsFontValid guards bite (or explicitly check the four asset files exist and load before proceeding).

detail: ink_soft also colors non-text shapes drawn in T2 captures — health-bar track fill, card borders, type-chip hairlines, spawn-ring strokes, chip outlines — so the re-bless contains non-text pixel drift, contradicting briefing rule 6 ("palette/layout unchanged") and lens-guard (b).
recommended_fix: Keep shape strokes on the old value: add a dedicated text-only ink entry for the 7.2:1 contrast ruling, or re-audit the T2 diff bboxes documenting the non-text bands under an explicit ruling.

title: noc_e2e captures moved BEFORE EndDrawing; retained comment now states the opposite
detail: The diff removed the EndDrawing that preceded the noc_e2e block, so TakeScreenshot (680/682) now runs mid-frame before the flush (693/698) — reintroducing the documented GPU-build hazard. The added comment claims the reverse; no EndTextureMode call exists anywhere in app code.
recommended_fix: Restore the order: end the frame (EndDrawing) before the noc_e2e screenshot block, and correct the comment — there is no EndTextureMode path.

title: font-check baseline probe loads assets/fonts/open_sans_regular.ttf, deleted by this PR
evidence:
font_check.odin:157-158:
	// 2. the mechanical ⚠-coverage probe (this candidate + the baseline).
	glyph_probe(font_path, rnd.FONT_BASE_SIZE)
	glyph_probe("assets/fonts/open_sans_regular.ttf", rnd.FONT_BASE_SIZE)
worktree assets/fonts/ contains only: ibm_plex_mono_regular.ttf, ibm_plex_sans_regular.ttf, ibm_plex_sans_semibold.ttf, noto_sans_symbols2_regular.ttf, OFL-IBM-Plex-Mono.txt, OFL-IBM-Plex-Sans.txt, OFL-Noto-Sans-Symbols2.txt (the diff deletes open_sans_regular.ttf).
detail: The same PR removes the file the baseline probe reads; glyph_probe only prints "cannot load" and returns — the before/after baseline evidence silently vanished from the A/B tool.
recommended_fix: Point the baseline probe at a committed asset (e.g. rnd.FONT_ASSET) or drop the baseline call.

title: glyph_probe indexes raylib's compacted glyph array by codepoint position — misaligned verdicts + OOB read
detail: A candidate lacking any probe codepoint (the U+26A0 negative-control case: 95 glyphs for 96 requested) compacts the array — f.glyphs[95] reads past the allocation and every row after the gap reports the wrong codepoint's metrics.
recommended_fix: Match by value like font_test.odin's font_probe_warning does (find g where g.value == cp) and bound the loop by f.glyphCount.

title: run_demo_to_ms duplicates overlay_check's stepping loop; its comment pasted twice
detail: The "shared driver" copies overlay_check's loop instead of replacing it — two ~30-line stepping implementations to keep in sync — and the hunk also pasted the lead comment twice above the original.
recommended_fix: Refactor overlay_check onto run_demo_to_ms (thread the per-tick hash collection through, e.g. a callback or optional slice) and delete the duplicated comment lines.

title: Stale comments still reference the removed load_hud_font proc
detail: The proc was removed this round; two comments still name it, and the old recipe never failed loud — it fell back to the default font.
recommended_fix: Update both comments to name load_fonts (and drop the false "FATAL" claim, per the blocker).

title: Score row: goal>0 variant bumped to 17px, goal-less variant left at 16px
detail: The 08-23 bigger-text bump raised the goal>0 branch to 17 but missed the else branch of the same HUD row — identical surface, two sizes.
recommended_fix: Bump the else branch to rnd.hud(&app.view, 17).

title: PP_SW_AUDIO gate has no in-repo build provider
detail: The SW gallery build requires -define:PP_SW_AUDIO=true, but nothing in the repo passes it — the build path exists only as undocumented manual command knowledge.
recommended_fix: Add the SW gallery build command (a tools/ script or run-dev.sh flag) that sets the define.
